paite: Asa kum sawmthum-le-guk avaihawm kum in Israel kumpipa Baasha in Judahte asual a, Judah kumpipa kiang a lut ding leh pawt ding dalna ding in Ramah khua abawl hi.
heading: Israel Toh Buainate / (1 Kum 15.17-22)

paite: Huchi in Asa in TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn a gou dangkasik leh dangka-engte alakhia a, Damaskas a Siria kumpipa Ben-hadad kiang ah,

"Ka pa leh na pa kal a thukhun a-om bang mah in i kikal ah thukhun a-om a, ngai dih, dangkasik leh dangka-engte ka hon khak ahi; kisa dih, Israel kumpipa Baasha in ahon tawpsanna ding in akiang ah na thukhun phel nawn mai in," chi in akhak hi.
Huchi in Ben-hadad in kumpipa Asa thu ana pom a; Israel khuate sual ding in sepaih heutute asawl a, Ijon khua, Dan khua, Abel-maim khua, Naphtali gam a vankoihna khua tengteng asual uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Baasha in huai thu azak in Ramah khua abawl lai akhawlsan a, athilhih tup akikhelsakta hi.
Huchi in kumpipa Asa in Judah mi tengteng api a. Baasha in Ramah khua bawlna ding a suang leh sing azatte ala vek ua, huaite in Geba leh Mizpah khua abawl hi.
Huai lai in zawlnei Hanani Judah kumpipa Asa kiang ah ahong a, akiang ah, "TOUPA na Pathian muang lou in Siria kumpipa na muang a, huaiziak in Siria kumpipa sepaihhonte na khahta ahi.
heading: Zawlnei Hanani

paite: Ethiopiate leh Libiate sepaihhon liantak, kangtalai leh sakol tungtuang mite tampi ahi kei uh maw? Himahleh TOUPA na muan ziak in na khut ah ahon pia hi.
Amah lam a lungsim diktak pu mite tung a ahatdan hihlang ding in leitung tengteng ah TOUPA mit avak dundun hi. Haihuai mahmah in thil na hihta a; tuban dou na nei gige ding," achi hi.
Huchi in zawlnei tung ah Asa aheh a, suangkul ah akhumta a; athugen ziak in aheh mahmah mai hi. Asa in mi khenkhatte leng asimmoh behlap lai hi.
Huan ngai dih ua, Asa tanchin abul a kipan a atawp pha in Judah leh Israel kumpipate tanchin gelhna bu ah gelh in a-om hi.
heading: Asa Vaihawm Sung Leh Asihna / (1 Kum 15.23,24)

paite: Kum sawmthum-le-kua vai ahawm kum in Asa khe ahong na a; anatna thupitak ahi; himahleh anatna ah TOUPA zong lou in damdawi siamte azong zaw hi.
Huchi in api-le-pute kiang ah Asa a-ihmu a, kum sawmli-le-khat avaihawm kum in asita hi.
David khopi a amah a tuam dia ahankhuk ah avui ua, gimlimtak, gimlim bawl mite'n gimlim chí tuamtuam a dim a kibawl lupna ah asial ua, amah zahtakna in meikuang thupi mahmah asem uhi.
